objective: Build an evidence-driven loop that improves the offset-1 A2D policy and evaluates it from offline diagnostics through calibrated Isaac rollouts and a later world-model proxy
acceptance_criteria: Every compared checkpoint is bound to immutable source, data, split, stats, config, seed, step, and artifact identities
A frozen E0-E3 evaluation funnel ranks candidates without treating offline loss as task success
At least one controlled offset-1 model iteration is selected from measured failure evidence
The first real case produces concrete requirements for the generic Loop runner and future schema 3

steps.title: Establish repository and evaluation baseline
steps.outcome: A source-backed map of the existing trainer, policies, artifacts, evaluation harness, and blockers
steps.verification: docs/LOOP_FIRST_INSTANCE.md references commit fd2b751 and concrete repository files
evidence: Repository commit fd2b751 mapped; docs/LOOP_FIRST_INSTANCE.md records existing capabilities, evidence levels, and blockers

steps.title: Resolve remote data and artifact state
steps.outcome: Exact offset-1 dataset, split, stats, run, step, checkpoint, and exposure identities are known
steps.verification: Read-only manifests, hashes, resolved configs, W&B/run IDs, and artifact locations are recorded
evidence: Read-only audit of yurui_dev_flowmatching_issac resolved source commit, 1090-episode offset-1 dataset and split hashes, active W&B run xifmcqbp, checkpoint/bundle identities, and current metrics; remaining evidence is label semantics, trial exposure, and the actual Isaac node.
steps.status_reason: Training-machine artifact state is resolved, but this SSH target has no detectable Isaac runtime/assets and rollout exposure identities remain unknown.

steps.title: Freeze and implement offline evaluation contract
steps.outcome: E0-E2 metrics run with fixed samples and seeds and emit a comparable report
steps.verification: Tests plus a versioned evaluation manifest and report for at least one offset-1 checkpoint

steps.title: Calibrate Isaac evaluation environment
steps.outcome: Observation, action, timing, physics, and success-checker gates pass on the designated Isaac machine
steps.verification: GT replay and calibration artifacts pass the staged rollout checklist

steps.title: Run one controlled model iteration
steps.outcome: One falsifiable model or training change is compared against the valid offset-1 baseline
steps.verification: Matched-step E0-E2 comparison with explicit promote, retry, or stop decision

steps.title: Run closed-loop candidate comparison
steps.outcome: Candidates receive paired diagnostic and promotion rollout evidence with stage failures and uncertainty
steps.verification: Isaac report binds checkpoint, trial-role manifests, seeds, simulator contract, and metrics

steps.title: Pilot world-model proxy evaluation
steps.outcome: A compatible world-model evaluator is tested for ranking correlation without becoming promotion authority prematurely
steps.verification: Independent checkpoint/trial study reports correlation, calibration, and false-promotion rate against rollout outcomes

steps.title: Refine the generic Loop from case evidence
steps.outcome: Runner and schema changes are limited to requirements repeatedly observed in this project
steps.verification: A reviewed change list maps each generic mechanism to concrete case evidence and tests

feedback.message: The first live case exposed an actionable model-selection signal: RGB-only best EMA val action MSE 0.0086918 is materially worse than the preceding proprioceptive run at 0.0037390, while validation loss degrades after early epochs. The Loop must distinguish run completion from checkpoint promotion and compare best checkpoints under fixed E0-E2 evidence.

SSH target yurui_dev_flowmatching_issac currently exposes an A800 training environment but no project USD/USDA assets, Isaac/Omniverse process, or importable isaacsim/omni/isaaclab packages; identify the actual configured Isaac machine before E3 calibration.
